fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-11-07
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-06 11:30 to 2026-11-07 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: four, all unchanged (no new escalation this cycle). Each is a draft decision in the group log; details are in the records.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 8 days): enforce in schema, in a validator, or stop claiming them as standard. Recommendation: audit, then enforce names in the schema and the core reservation in a validator. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 8 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: merge srs#991 as drafted, with a downstream audit first. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 3 days): the only srs-web ready item is UI work. Recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 10 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
Also waiting on you: srs#1009 (RFC-054 draft, gate:owner-merge).

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. No merged PR named a proposed decision as "decision <id>: assent", so no session was held. The six merges executed existing rulings (see 3).

3. Done: 6 PRs merged, all builder agent:tpr-builder / reviewer agent:tpr-reviewer, verdict approve, gates green:
- srs-rust#1587 diagnosticsStructured (#1339 slice 7), mandate bf4a5af5/00567bf1
- srs-web#753 navigation identity optional, mandate RFC-029 Change D / rfc-decision-9ee14517
- srs-rust#1589 bundled readme (RFC-045 slice 1 of 3), mandate RFC-045 [R1][R2][R4][R5]
- srs-web#756 load gate filters on revisionStep, mandate rfc-decision-9ee14517
- srs-rust#1590 missing packageId is an error, mandate RFC-044 [R11]
- srs-rust#1591 Field id in type_schema, one find facet per Field, mandate RFC-053 (srs#998)

4. Stuck or lost: nothing stopped, no needs-input items, no red gates reported. Open group PRs: srs#1009 (owner-merge, waits on you), srs#1005 (rename core-bundle, waiting for review), srs-rust#1588 (type subtypes, waiting for review), srs-rust#1575 and #1574 (auto-merge armed, waiting on green or review). Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 6 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 4 open (3 count against the budget; srs#1009 is owner-merge). Pause state: running (the last 3 reports are acknowledged).
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.

6. Next: 6 issues carry ready + wg:third-party-ready (srs-rust 4, srs 1, srs-web 1; srs-vscode 0). Top 3 in builder order (all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#1164 (RFC-045 readme carry, partly landed via #1589), srs-rust#1339 (structured diagnostics, partly landed via #1587), srs#928 (RFC needed: Composition display title, in flight as srs#1009). Local priorities: none set. Queue fed for about 1 cycle at the current pace (several of the 6 are already partly or wholly in flight; srs-web#691 waits on escalation bc6bc746). Queue running dry: 6 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: the divergence diff and drift list are the sources. Fed by the analyst: wg-analyst run 2026-10-23, filed 1, nominated 3.
6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: the quorum line names a mandate on every merge and the builder and reviewer stayed inside it, which is the concept holding. Four escalations have waited 3 to 10 days with no ruling, so the owner's queue, not the group's capacity, is what limits the work. Measurement I1 for the cycle window is 0/0 (the window handed to `measure` opened at this close), so it says nothing yet: result 6107b41c-c1a4-4c6f-9749-564acf51fd1f; whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalation was raised: the four items outside the boundary are already open as draft decisions in the group log (21b6b4b7, 864eaebf, bc6bc746, c7a8e0a2). Nothing was ratified because no merged PR carried a decision assent.
